chose: The owner previews the public site from a branch on their own machine with one command, `pnpm --filter www preview:pages`: it fetches the newest site media from main's producer runs with gh, builds www with the Pages build's environment through turbo as pages.yml does, and serves apps/www/dist with vite preview at http://localhost:4173/some-ui/. pages.yml's media step moved, unchanged in what it takes and refuses, into apps/www/scripts/fetch-site-media.sh, which both run, so there is one copy. The owner (2026-11-22): "so we don't pay for the expensive github page release build nonesense, I can actually run the build on that branch on my machine so I can approve how it looks before merging to main."
options: one command that fetches main's media with gh, builds as Pages does and serves at the base path, sharing pages.yml's fetch script
a Pages preview build per pull request, uploaded as an artifact
a static build with no media, every slot drawing its placeholder
gray: How the owner sees a branch's landing before merging is theirs to notice in how they work: a CI preview costs the Actions minutes they want to save, and one without media shows a page unlike the deploy.
undo: Remove preview:pages and scripts/preview-pages.sh from apps/www, and move fetch-site-media.sh's body back into pages.yml's "Fetch the site's media" step.
